arStrings.szText: {c_important}Poison Imbuement{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|x%|]{/c} increased Potency. Each successive time an enemy is Poisoned by {c_important}Poison Imbuement{/c}, the Potency of {c_important}Poison Imbuement{/c} against the enemy is increased by {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|x%|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_9}*{SF_10}*100|x%|]{/c}.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Poison Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|%|]{/c} chance to {u}{c_important}Fortify{/c}{/u} you {c_number}[{SF_39}*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life. 

While imbued, your {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} heals you {c_number}[{SF_40}*100|%|]{/c} faster.

{c_label}Passive:{/c} {c_important}Poison Imbuement{/c} corrodes enemies around you, dealing {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_C_POISON_DOT}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[SF_31]{/c} seconds.

While imbued, the size of the corrosion is increased by {c_number}[{SF_32}|+%|]{/c}. Each enemy affected by {c_important}Poison Imbuement{/c} increases your Energy Regeneration by {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|x%|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_30}*{SF_26}*100|x%|]{/c}.
Casting {c_important}Poison Imbuement{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} Energy, increased by {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} for each Nearby Poisoned enemy.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Poison Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%|]{/c} chance to reduce the Cooldown of {c_important}Poison Imbuement{/c} by {c_number}[SF_19]{/c} seconds.
Critical Strikes with {c_important}Poison Imbued{/c} Skills increase its Poisoning damage by {c_number}[{SF_14} * 100|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Poison Imbuement's{/c} duration is increased by {c_number}{SF_42}{/c} seconds. Casting {c_important}Poison Imbuement{/c} consumes up to {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} to further increase its duration by {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} per {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} spent.
